source_of_truth: Mains, sides and buffet service standards inferred from Riviera built-ins and approved service-variant patterns.

plated_main.portion: 170 g cooked lamb, 50 ml jus, 80 g Provençale veg, 5 g gremolata per guest
plated_main.service_rule: Hold lamb in jus at 78-80 C; veg and gremolata separate until pass.

buffet.portion: 170 g cooked lamb with jus per guest
buffet.service_rule: Serve lamb covered in jus from GN; refresh jus level during service.

plated_main.portion: 180 g bourguignon per guest; optional 100 g mash/purée base
plated_main.premium_garnish_option: Micro parsley, picked thyme or crisp lardon crumb.
plated_main.service_rule: Hold gently at 78-80 C; do not boil once beef is in sauce.

buffet.portion: 180 g bourguignon per guest
buffet.premium_garnish_option: Micro parsley, picked thyme or crisp lardon crumb.
buffet.service_rule: Each scoop should include beef, sauce, mushroom, lardon and onion.

corporate_boxed.portion: not recommended unless sold as controlled hot boxed meal
corporate_boxed.reason: Wet braise needs proper hot holding and is not a standard mixed-box item.

plated_main.portion: 1 chicken portion, 45 ml lemon caper cream, 5 g capers per guest
plated_main.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, fried capers or lemon zest.
plated_main.service_rule: Cook to 74 C internal; sauce separately at pass.

buffet.portion: 1 sliced chicken portion per guest
buffet.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, fried capers or lemon zest.
buffet.service_rule: Slice in shallow batches; hold covered with sauce protected.

plated_main.portion: 120 g cooked lamb, 35 ml pan jus, oregano finish per guest
plated_main.premium_garnish_option: Micro oregano, lemon zest or herb oil.
plated_main.service_rule: Carve against grain and sauce immediately.

buffet.portion: 120 g cooked lamb per guest
buffet.premium_garnish_option: Micro oregano, lemon zest or herb oil.
buffet.service_rule: Carve tableside or hold pulled/carved lamb covered in jus.

plated_main.portion: 1 prosciutto chicken portion, 50 ml sauce, 100 g chat potatoes, 25 g greens per guest
plated_main.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, fried capers or lemon zest.
plated_main.service_rule: Rest and slice on bias at pass; do not bury prosciutto in sauce.

buffet.portion: not recommended as open buffet
buffet.reason: Prosciutto-wrapped breast loses texture and moisture during open buffet holding.

plated_main.portion: 130 g raw fillet portion, 40 ml reduction, 100 g potato, 25 g greens per guest
plated_main.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, herb oil or crisp potato garnish.
plated_main.service_rule: Sear, oven finish, rest and sauce at pass only.

buffet.portion: not recommended as open buffet
buffet.reason: Fillet is too quality-sensitive for buffet holding and overcooks once sliced.

corporate_boxed.reason: Not suitable for standard boxed delivery due doneness and holding risk.

buffet.portion: 150 g pulled beef and jus per guest
buffet.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, lemon zest or oregano finish.
buffet.service_rule: Hold beef covered in jus at 75 C; tzatziki separate and labelled.

plated_main.portion: 150 g pulled beef, 45 ml jus, 15 g tzatziki per guest
plated_main.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, lemon zest or oregano finish.
plated_main.service_rule: Keep hot beef and cold tzatziki separate on plate.

buffet.portion: 1 chargrilled thigh fillet per guest
buffet.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, lemon zest or fried capers.
buffet.service_rule: Hold thighs whole where possible; slice at service and dress individual portions only.

plated_main.portion: 1 sliced thigh fillet, 20 ml dressing, caper-parsley finish per guest
plated_main.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, lemon zest or fried capers.
plated_main.service_rule: Add parsley to dressing at service only.

buffet.portion: 150 g gratin per guest
buffet.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or crisp cheese crumb.
buffet.service_rule: Rest before cutting; hold covered hot max 90 min.

platter.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or crisp cheese crumb.
platter.service_rule: Cut clean squares; reheat covered then uncover to refresh crust.

buffet.portion: 125 g roast chats, 20 g whipped feta, 8 ml herb oil per guest
buffet.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, parsley leaves or lemon zest.
buffet.service_rule: Re-crisp potatoes before service; feta and herb oil at service only.

platter.portion: portion by guest count, not individual pieces
platter.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, parsley leaves or lemon zest.
platter.service_rule: For delivery, send feta separate if holding time is long.

buffet.portion: 150 g vegetable gratin per guest
buffet.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or crisp herb crumb.
buffet.service_rule: Drain veg hard; rest before scooping; avoid stirring after baking.

platter.portion: portion by guest count, not individual pieces
platter.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or crisp herb crumb.
platter.service_rule: Serve hot from baking dish or GN with crust intact.
